verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a centralized rule system for defining and enforcing engineering standards. Its governance layer is built to enforce consistent standards across every repository automatically, Rule Miner can generate rules from PR history, and agents can retrieve the applicable rules and standards for a task. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the rule formats (natural-language rule authoring, AST/pattern-based rules, linking external style guides), detail on how findings map back to specific custom rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
